Current Concept: Granny Thistle is called the "witch of the wood," but was once a tower mage before they were given their freedom. She went back to her village, but found her family had long since passed away. With the coin she had earned, she had her old home restored, and she now serves as a "wise woman" to those willing to visit her.

The guards leave her alone since she is a legal mage, and has not done anything to give them reason to be concerned. She also has ties to the wood elves of Blackwood. She has gone as far as to swear an oath to the Green.

Current Concept:

Wadaksa is a long time friend of Granny Thistle. He met her when she was first brought to the mage tower when she was just a girl. As Wadaksa was not a mage himself, and not allowed in the tower, he posed as her familiar and assisted her in many ways.

While he did develop a deep love for Granny Thistle, he was also a spy for the  Commission, but abandoned his role when he began to suspect that they meant the tower harm.

Today, he lives with Granny Thistle, and still pretends to be her familiar so he can wander into town and gather information for Thistle. From time to time, if only to pass the time, Wadaksa deeply enjoys tormenting the corrupt guardsmen by "hiding" their looted coin.
